The '''Q-2''' was a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The design was licensed from [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and was nearly identical to Merr-Sonn's [[Q2 hold-out blaster]] pistol.
